name: Lip Salve
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: the best olive oil
ingredients.originalText: four ounces of the best olive oil

ingredients.name: the small parts of alkanet root
ingredients.originalText: one ounce of the small parts of alkanet root

ingredients.name: and a half of the best mutton suet
ingredients.originalText: one ounce and a half of the best mutton suet

ingredients.name: oil of roses or oil of neroli, or tincture of musk
ingredients.originalText: oil of roses or oil of neroli, or tincture of musk

instructions.text: Put into a wide-mouthed bottle four ounces of the best olive oil, with one ounce of the small parts of alkanet root
Stop up the bottle, and set it in the sun, shaking it often, till you find the liquid of a beautiful crimson
Strain off the oil very clear from the alkanet root, put it into an earthen pipkin
Add to it an ounce of white wax, and an ounce and a half of the best mutton suet, which has been previously clarified or boiled and skimmed
Set the mixture on the embers of coals, and melt it slowly, stirring it well
After it has simmered slowly for a little while, take it off
While still hot, mix with it a few drops of oil of roses, or of oil of neroli, or tincture of musk

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put into a wide-mouthed bottle four ounces of the best olive oil, with one ounce of the small parts of alkanet root
2. Stop up the bottle, and set it in the sun, shaking it often, till you find the liquid of a beautiful crimson
3. Strain off the oil very clear from the alkanet root, put it into an earthen pipkin
4. Add to it an ounce of white wax, and an ounce and a half of the best mutton suet, which has been previously clarified or boiled and skimmed
5. Set the mixture on the embers of coals, and melt it slowly, stirring it well
6. After it has simmered slowly for a little while, take it off
7. While still hot, mix with it a few drops of oil of roses, or of oil of neroli, or tincture of musk
